profile: Balchem develops, manufactures, distributes, and markets specialty ingredients and products for nutrition, food, pharmaceutical, animal health, plant nutrition, sterilization, fumigation, and industrial markets. Its human nutrition offerings include choline nutrients, mineral chelates, vitamin K2, and nutritional ingredients, alongside product development and microencapsulation solutions for food and beverage makers. Animal nutrition products include choline chloride, microencapsulated supplements, and chelated nutrients for livestock and companion animals.
